rationale: The task requests a user-visible change to an existing AGDF repository, but the supplied evidence contains no approved durable UR and no completed Brownfield Review with a recorded Mode/Slice Decision. AGDF therefore fails closed and cannot select a delivery path yet.
decision_grounds: The compact status card change affects visible UI/UX behavior and therefore requires a durable UR before routing or work
No exact `Approval: UR` and corresponding persisted or linked UR artefact are evidenced
No completed Brownfield Review or evidenced Mode/Slice Decision is provided
Compact Delivery cannot be selected because approved UR, completed Brownfield analysis, and stored `quick_task` context—
The earliest permissible action is UR formulation/approval, not delivery-path selection
